validation.registryLicenseInventoryScope: All 189 unique exact-version registry packages in both shipped Cargo.lock files, including build/test/target-specific dependencies; not a precise compiled-WASM SBOM.

scopeNotes: Only OFT and SAC manager are USPC-deployed Rust contracts.
The Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) is a native Stellar contract, not an additional custom Rust WASM in this package.
Endpoint and ULN WASMs are ABI/specification helpers for calling existing LayerZero infrastructure; these are not USPC deployments.
No ownership of LayerZero protocol deployment or blanket MIT licensing is claimed. See LICENSES.md.
Deployment-record hash matches are historical evidence, not a fresh live-ledger verification.
Build outputs are intentionally different: OFT unoptimized; SAC manager optimized.
